name: Parity of three bits
arch:
A multilayer perceptron with 3 inputs, one hidden layer of 3 ReLU units, and 1 output:
  h = relu(x @ W1 + b1)    W1: 3 x 3
  out = h @ W2 + b2        W2: 3 x 1
context: Each input is a bit (0 or 1). The output bit is 1 when out > 0.

answer.short: x1 XOR x2 XOR x3 (odd number of ones)
answer.detail: Hand-written weights; verified on the full truth table.

source: Written by hand in this repo (lab/targets/build_registry.py).

domain.text: The network is used on every input of 3 values that are each 0 or 1 (8 inputs).
